name: MPT
effects: Shulgin TiHKAL #34: inactive at ≤20 mg oral

mechanismOfAction.summary: Presumed 5-HT2A partial agonist (no published binding affinity data); may be inactive orally based on Shulgin self-trials.
mechanismOfAction.description: Substituted tryptamine; N-methyl, N-propyl disubstitution. Crystal structure solved (Chadeayne et al. 2019). Shulgin (TiHKAL #34) reported no effect at oral doses tested; threshold and dose ranges undocumented. Human psychedelic activity unconfirmed. Cross-tolerance with 5-HT2A psychedelics would be expected if psychedelic effects are confirmed.
